title: Music Map
text:
Every person becomes a short document: the sentence they wrote about how their song makes them feel. The workflow turns those sentences into tf-idf vectors, projects them to two dimensions with PCA, and uses lightweight clustering to name taste neighborhoods.
Color shows the learned taste neighborhood. The map intentionally does not encode role or program because the DATA 117 survey does not collect that information.

Reading the axes

PC1 explains approximately 6.0% of the variance. Positive terms include: relaxed, happy, happy relaxed, very happy, calm relaxed, energized happy.
PC2 explains approximately 5.6% of the variance. Positive terms include: relaxed, calm, calm relaxed, very calm, happy relaxed, hyped.

title: DATA 117 Fall 2026 Cohort
text:
Welcome to the DATA 117 Fall 2026 Cohort Snapshot.
This site is a living picture of our class community: where we come from, how we define artificial intelligence, what inspires us, and the music we chose to represent ourselves.
Responses are collected through a Google Form and automatically transformed into visualizations, a musical taste map, an AI-definition word cloud, and a class playlist.

title: Behind the Scenes
text:
The music map uses the sentence each person wrote about how their song makes them feel. The AI word cloud uses the one-sentence definition of artificial intelligence from the survey.


Code
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
src=Path("docs_data/responses_anon.csv")
if src.exists():
    df=pd.read_csv(src)
    if "ai_definition" in df:
        display(df["ai_definition"].dropna().head(3).tolist())
